# 0thernes Research Archive (2026.11.26)

> Canonical public master vault, live ecosystem mirror, and Mega-Atlas V2 cross-reference bridge for Alexander Stephen Donahue (Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA; ORCID 0009-0006-8168-9648). Tracks 47 public research entries (18 Tier I preprints, 17 Tier II build papers & Lean 4 suites, 12 Tier III laws/discoveries/atlases) with byte-exact SHA-256 provenance and zero private repository leakage.
